title: Positive parenting predicts the development of adolescent brain structure: a longitudinal study

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Positive parenting predicts the development of adolescent brain structure: a longitudinal study》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】The aim of this study was to prospectively investigate the effects of positive (warm and supportive) maternal behavior on structural brain development during adolescence, using longitudinal structural MRI.
